data.claim: The append-only event log requires a property that is distinct from or strictly stronger than RFC 9110 idempotence: either deterministic-replay idempotence (replay of a sequence reproduces the same final state regardless of delivery multiplicity), operational deduplication (a mechanical guarantee that duplicate physical writes are collapsed), or write-ordered idempotence (duplicate writes suppressed and ordering of non-duplicate writes preserved). RFC 9110 idempotence is order-insensitive and defined over individual HTTP method semantics, not over ordered sequences of operations with causality.
